technical.lead: FMRB EO Monday hold: classified-annex triply-aged into Memorial Day pause
technical.body: The Frontier Model Review Board executive order moved into its Memorial Day federal observance with the now-triply-aged eight-of-eight Friday classified-annex close holding as a three-day-old artifact and OSTP holding its 'signing window open from end-of-day May 22 forward' line through the federal-holiday Monday without any holiday signing activity, leaving Tuesday May 26 as the operative first-business-signing-window target and the post-deadline arithmetic converting from a three-day weekend hold into a settled Memorial Day federal observance hold. A Monday Lawfare federal-holiday note characterized the now-cleared Senate Cyber Subcommittee classified-annex response curve — NSA Director, FBI Cyber Division Assistant Director, and OMB Federal CIO substantive responses all logged Friday and unchanged through the federal-holiday Monday — as the canonical triply-aged settled-state input the post-Memorial-Day Tuesday OSTP signing-window calendar will run against, with no fresh Memorial Day revisions to the eight-witness response record. A Monday Just Security analysis observed that the triply-aged classified-annex close sits as the cleanest pre-business-Tuesday settled-state reading the FMRB process has produced and that the OECD GENAI plenary cohort plus the House parallel-track cohort can both continue to cite the eight-of-eight close as a stable shared regulatory anchor heading into the Tuesday business reopen. The House Energy and Commerce Subcommittee on Communications and Technology continued to hold its Wednesday May 27 morning markup slot on the parallel 30-day technical-review joint-resolution draft cleanly through the Memorial Day federal observance without modification.

technical.lead: Cerebras CBRS Monday: HKEX ADR sole Memorial Day price-discovery surface
technical.body: Cerebras CBRS U.S.-listed tape sat closed for the Memorial Day federal observance with the international cross-listing tape carrying the only Monday trading activity and Friday's post-event reaction tape now sitting as the triply-aged settled fourth-consecutive-session upper-half-of-analyst-band read on the primary U.S. listing. A Monday BEAMSTART federal-holiday note reported the Hong Kong Stock Exchange depositary-receipt cross-listing trading inside Friday's HKD-equivalent close range with the five-desk analyst spread holding Friday's tightening for a third consecutive non-trading day on the primary listing — Bernstein's $185 Market-Perform floor still held, Morgan Stanley's $192 target with the upside-scenario probability at Friday's 54 percent (now holding cleanly through three holiday-equivalent days above the half-probability threshold), Wells Fargo Securities Buy at $220, Jefferies Outperform at $225, and UBS Neutral at $215 — with institutional-buyside cumulative net position holding at Friday's roughly 44 percent of float through the closing Memorial Day federal observance and the cohort flagging the now-triply-aged FMRB classified-annex eight-of-eight close as the canonical settled second-order regulatory-anchor input the federal-holiday market closure rests against. A Monday AIwire federal-holiday note observed the HKEX ADR international tape served as the only Monday Cerebras price-discovery surface and printed inside Friday's primary-listing range without fresh divergence, consistent with the cross-listing behavior the prior federal-holiday closures established, with the Memorial Day recap reading characterizing the U.S. market closure as the canonical three-day signal-to-noise settling window and Tuesday May 26 as the operative next concrete primary-listing tape catalyst session.
